versions.changelog:
Initial release with robust domain name brainstorming and availability checking features.

- Generates creative, relevant domain name ideas based on your project description.
- Checks domain availability across multiple TLDs (.com, .io, .dev, .ai, .app, etc.).
- Provides branding insights and explains why suggested names work well.
- Offers alternative name variations if top choices are taken.
- Supports advanced workflows, including keyword-based ideas, industry-specific TLDs, and multilingual options.
- Includes tips and best practices for domain selection, branding, and registration.
